existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decreased plasma PGF2alpha concentration is the same event as the plasma member of this group, differing only in wording.
Increased PPAR-alpha activation is the directional opposite of the decreased PPAR-alpha activation member for the same receptor.

new_groups.rationale: Both concern smooth muscle but describe proliferation/clonal expansion versus hypertrophy/hyperplasia, which are related but distinct processes.
Hyperplasia in different ovarian cell types (stromal cells vs epithelium).
Decreased bile flow and increased cholestasis share the bile object but are distinct events needing curator review.
